_doc: Spec purpose files: what each spec/use-case is meant to do, the loop it runs, and why the community takes each talent the model would otherwise mis-value (from loop_audit.py). Roles: enabler (the loop does not work without it), control (positioning/safety that keeps the loop running), safety (deaths/emergencies), throughput, sustain, utility, filler (cheapest legal path to a deeper talent - the model may legitimately pick a different filler), avoid (harms the loop). 'encoded' says how the reason is expressed in the manual effect files; sources are the guides the reason comes from.

fury-dw-raid.purpose: Dual-wield Fury: Bloodthirst, Whirlwind, Heroic Strike rage dump, Flurry from crits, Impale from 17 Arms points.
loop: Heroic Strike / Hamstring to dump rage
Overpower swaps to Battle Stance when it procs (Tactical Mastery keeps the rage)
constraints: rage is the resource: hit count, Unbridled Wrath and Anger Management feed it

Tactical Mastery.why: 'Required for stance swapping to work. Without points in it, you would struggle to retain any Rage when stance swapping.'

Unbridled Wrath.why: 'Suits dual wielding well, as the more often you attack, the more often you activate this talent.'

Anger Management.why: 'Generates 1 Rage every 3 seconds' and lets you enter fights with rage.

Cruelty.why: 'Trading one talent point for 1% extra chance to critical strike is usually a good deal.'

Impale.why: 'Major damage contributor for Warriors, while only requiring an investment of 17 points into the Arms tree.'

Improved Overpower.why: Makes Overpower 'critical strike much more often' and 'can be useful to activate Flurry'.

Improved Battle Shout.why: Brings improved battle shout to 4 others (a party shout: four melee in the warrior's group); worth classic-era: +3.5% per receiver (buff_value.py).

Enrage.why: Fury tier-3: five points are needed to reach Death Wish and Flurry, and Enrage (+damage after taking a hit) is the best of that tier's options; it rarely triggers for a raid DPS warrior.

prot-tank.purpose: Shield tank: Sunder Armor / Revenge / Shield Slam threat, Shield Block against crushing blows, Last Stand and Shield Wall for emergencies.
loop: Revenge when it lights up, Shield Slam on cooldown
Shield Block before boss swings, Heroic Strike with spare rage
constraints: rage-starved on pulls and low-damage bosses: Anger Management, Improved Bloodrage
defense/armor talents are priced honestly (Icy Veins is lukewarm on Anticipation and Toughness)

Anticipation.why: 'Not quite as good as it might look at first glance. While 10 Defense is a strong defensive boost, it comes at the cost of 5 precious talent points.'
Anticipation.encoded: surv +0.6%/rank tank (derived from defense -> avoidance and crit)

Toughness.why: 'Looks better on paper than what it actually is. Only your armor value from items is increased.'

Improved Shield Wall.why: 'Taken specifically because, at this point, you should be tanking bosses where the 5 extra seconds will make or break a kill.'

Tactical Mastery.why: 'Required for stance swapping' (Charge / Mocking Blow / Berserker Rage swaps).

Improved Shield Block.why: 'Your best defensive one pointer' - two blocks per Shield Block removes crushing blows.

Shield Specialization.why: 'Requirement for the specialization-defining Improved Shield Block.'

Improved Sunder Armor.why: -1 rage/rank on Sunder Armor, the tank's threat filler (35% of the threat split): rage economy the threat model does not carry beyond the ability's cost; a Protection tier-2 point spend.

arms-2h-raid.purpose: Two-hander leveling: Charge, Rend, Overpower on dodges, Heroic Strike / Mortal Strike, Sweeping Strikes on packs.
constraints: rage from Charge and white hits is the limiter; Tactical Mastery lets Charge (Battle) flow into Berserker Stance

Improved Heroic Strike.why: Cheaper rage dump: more Heroic Strikes per pull.

Tactical Mastery.why: Charge in Battle Stance, fight in Berserker without losing the rage.

Unbridled Wrath.why: Extra rage per hit (half as often with a two-hander).

Improved Rend.why: Rend is applied every pull; Blood Craze/Enrage synergy.

Improved Battle Shout.why: Brings improved battle shout to 4 others (a party shout: four melee in the warrior's group); worth classic-era: +3.5% per receiver (buff_value.py).
